mapper.select: SELECT id, followerId, followeeId, createTime FROM user_follow WHERE followerId = #{followerId} AND followeeId = #{followeeId} LIMIT 1

SELECT u.id, u.userName, u.userAvatar, uf.createTime AS followTime FROM user_follow uf INNER JOIN user u ON uf.followeeId = u.id WHERE uf.followerId = #{userId} AND u.isDelete = 0 ORDER BY uf.createTime DESC

SELECT u.id, u.userName, u.userAvatar, uf.createTime AS followTime, EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM user_follow uf2 WHERE uf2.followerId = #{currentUserId} AND uf2.followeeId = u.id ) AS isFollowing FROM user_follow uf INNER JOIN user u ON uf.followerId = u.id WHERE uf.followeeId = #{userId} AND u.isDelete = 0 ORDER BY uf.createTime DESC
SELECT followeeId FROM user_follow WHERE followerId = #{followerId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_follow WHERE followerId = #{followerId} AND followeeId = #{followeeId}
